glossary.role: Formal name of the lunar state that declared independence from Earth
Common short name of the Unified Empire of Giganos
YGMA-14 Gilgazamune, giant thought-controlled Metal Armor (Gon Jem's prototype; Heidelnecken and Dorchenov versions)
Giganos hardliner; as Lieutenant Colonel he assassinates Marshal Guiltorre and becomes Supreme Leader of Giganos; pilots a black Gilgazamune at the end
glossary.personality: Arrogant, power-hungry, cruel and treacherous; bullies subordinates; strong MA pilot but a poor commander

glossary.role: Marshal Iskander Guiltorre, leader of the Giganos Empire, assassinated in the story.

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness

glossary.role: Giganos Captain, the only woman among Gon Jem's Four Kings; Stark Dyne pilot; later joins Meio
glossary.personality: Fierce, violent and battle-hungry; later shows a devoted, gentler side toward Meio

glossary.note: army/MS rank; a ship's captain (艦長) is also Captain

report.translator_summary: Translated Operation 12 Phase 4 and Debriefing (Giganos Space Fortress), completing Operation 12. Covers the conclusion of Phase 3 where the microwave satellite disables the fortress, Linda Plato's tactical briefing on preventing the falling fortress from impacting the Moon, infiltration to destroy the control system, Min's broadcast scheme tricking Dorchenov into publicly confessing his assassination of Marshal Guiltorre, Meio and Kaine defeating Dorchenov in his Gilgazamune, Kaine humorously convincing Meio to live as his 'future brother-in-law', and Captain Sinapus's debriefing marking the official end of the war with Giganos as Meio and Min formally join the Albion.
report.rows_examined: m6123#77 to m6123#85, brief63086#2 to brief63086#5, m6124#0 to m6124#59, brief63179#0 to brief63179#4, along with context before (m6123#65-76).
uncertainties: In m6124#48-49, Kaine's declaration of himself as Meio's '未来の義弟' (future brother-in-law) due to his pursuit of Linda Plato is embraced dryly by Meio ('未来の義弟に、しばらく手を貸すとしようか'). Both the banter and humor are preserved.
In m6124#20-22, Dorchenov's villainous pride leads him to brazenly boast into Min's live open transmitter about shooting Marshal Guiltorre ('ずばりこのワシだ！'), breaking Giganos morale.
In brief63179#0-4, Captain Sinapus delivers the final debrief of Operation 12, marking the end of the Giganos war and the fleet's planned return to Earth alongside the Nadesico.
